faqs.question: What does ScaleHaven actually do?
faqs.answer: We're a done-for-you growth agency for med spas and aesthetic clinics. We run Facebook and Instagram ads (Meta), Google Ads, SEO, and conversion-first web design, then deliver financially qualified patients booked straight into the booking system you already use. No new software, nothing to integrate. You send raw video footage. We handle scripts, editing, ad copy, campaigns, follow-up systems, and reporting. We guarantee 15+ booked consultations in month one or we work free until you hit that target.

faqs.question: How is your 15-consultation guarantee structured?
faqs.answer: If you don't get 15 booked consultations in your first month, we keep working for free until you do. No partial refunds, no fine print. We can offer this because we specialize in this niche and know exactly what converts.

faqs.question: How much do I need to spend on ads?
faqs.answer: Most clients invest $1,500-5,000/month in ad spend. We recommend starting at $2,000-3,000/month for a single-location clinic. Our management fee is separate. At $3K/month in ad spend, most practices see 40-80+ leads and 15-25 booked consultations.

faqs.question: Do you only do Meta Ads, or other channels too?
faqs.answer: Meta Ads (Facebook + Instagram) is our core service because it has the highest ROI for med spas, but we also offer Google Ads management, SEO and local search optimization, and optional follow-up automation as an add-on. Most clients start with Meta and add other channels as they scale.

faqs.question: What kind of clinics do you work with?
faqs.answer: Med spas, aesthetic clinics, cosmetic clinics, skincare clinics, dermatology practices, laser clinics, plastic surgery practices, and solo aesthetic providers (RN injectors, NPs). We work with any clinic offering aesthetic treatments: Botox, fillers, laser, body contouring, GLP-1 weight loss, microneedling, chemical peels, and more.

faqs.question: Where are you based and who do you serve?
faqs.answer: ScaleHaven is based in the United States and Canada, and we serve clinics across both countries. Our team works remotely with clinics in every major market.

faqs.question: Do I need a long-term contract?
faqs.answer: No. We work month-to-month after the initial 90-day ramp-up period. Most clients stay because the results speak for themselves, but we don't lock you in.

faqs.question: How quickly will I see results?
faqs.answer: Ads typically launch within 5-7 days of onboarding. Most clients see their first booked consultations within the first 2 weeks. Month one is focused on hitting the 15+ consultation guarantee.
